items.exampleEn: The museum had many visitors on Sunday.
items.exampleZh: 博物館星期天有很多參觀者。

items.exampleEn: Traffic in this city is terrible.

items.exampleZh: 飛行員需要好幾年的訓練。

items.exampleEn: All passengers must show their tickets.
items.exampleZh: 所有乘客都必須出示車票。

items.exampleEn: In summer, the beach is full of tourists.
items.exampleZh: 夏天海灘上滿是觀光客。

items.exampleEn: The journey from Taipei to Hualien takes two hours by train.
items.exampleZh: 從台北搭火車到花蓮要兩個小時。
我很愛看冒險故事的書。

items.exampleEn: The astronaut stayed in space for six months.
items.exampleZh: 那位太空人在太空待了六個月。

items.sentenceEn: There is heavy traffic on the bridge.

items.audioEn: Hello, passengers. This is your pilot. We will land in Tokyo at six.
items.audioZh: 各位乘客好，我是機長。我們將在六點降落東京。

items.sentenceEn: The journey was long but fun.
items.sentenceZh: 這趟旅程很長，但很好玩。

items.sentenceEn: Tourists love the night markets here.
items.sentenceZh: 觀光客很愛這裡的夜市。

items.stemEn: Climbing that mountain was a big ____.
items.stemZh: 爬那座山是一場大冒險。

items.passageEn: When Tom was a child, he wanted to be an astronaut. Now he is a pilot. Every day, he flies hundreds of passengers to different cities. Many of them are tourists or business visitors. Tom says every journey is a small adventure. But there is one thing he doesn't like: the traffic on his way to the airport!
items.passageZh: Tom 小時候想當太空人，現在他是一名機師。他每天載著幾百名乘客飛往不同的城市，其中很多是觀光客或來洽公的訪客。Tom 說每一趟旅程都是一場小冒險。不過有一件事他不喜歡：去機場路上的車潮！

items.promptZh: 這座城市每年都有很多觀光客。
referenceEn: This city has many tourists every year.
Many tourists come to this city every year.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 This city has…、Many tourists come to…

items.instructionZh: 用 journey 造一個句子，說說一趟你記得的旅程。
referenceEn: My first journey by plane was very exciting.
Our train journey across Taiwan was wonderful.
rubricZh: journey 表示「旅程；路程」（例如 a long journey、my first journey）
時態配合句意（例如 was）
